name: Shadow Claw's initial hit chains like its debuff (#5357)
contract: Shadow Claw 800697 (client Spell.dbc): Effect[0] is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA (the periodic debuff, Amplitude 2000 ms, no SPELL_ATTR5_START_PERIODIC_AT_APPLY so the first tick lands 2 sec after cast) with EffectChainTarget[0]=3; Effect[1] is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE (the up-front hit the tooltip 'Deals X Shadow Damage to up to $i enemies' describes) but shipped with EffectChainTarget[1]=0, so only the explicit target ever took the initial hit while the debuff chained to up to 3 targets. AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp's ApplyContracts now copies Effects[EFFECT_0].ChainTarget onto Effects[EFFECT_1] for id 800697, so both effects reach the same up-to-3 enemies. DmgClass 1 (magic) with no SPELL_ATTR4_BOUNCY_CHAIN_MISSILES makes Spell::SearchChainTargets use a 10 yd per-jump, bouncing-far radius (searchRadius = 10 * chainTargets), so three fixtures 1-2 yd apart are all in range from the explicit target. Checking spell_damage_count well before the first periodic tick (2000 ms) isolates the instant Effect[1] hit from the aura's own damage.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
CONTROL: the explicit target takes the up-front hit
CONTROL: the debuff already reaches the second chain target
CONTROL: the debuff already reaches the third chain target
DISCRIMINATING: the up-front hit also reaches the second chain target, before its first periodic tick
DISCRIMINATING: the up-front hit also reaches the third chain target, before its first periodic tick
